title: file sink
description: Writes the message body to a file in a directory. Headers and metadata are not written.

path.title: Directory
path.description: Directory to write to, from the URI (file:<directory>)

fileName.title: File name
fileName.description: Name of the file; defaults to the header file.name, else the message's trace id

fileExist.title: File exist
fileExist.description: What to do when the file exists: Override, Append, Fail (error) or Ignore (skip)
